# 设置自动追加保证金 (TRADE)

- **POST** `/capi/v3/account/modifyAutoAppendMargin`

权重(IP): 15

**请求参数**

| 参数名 | 类型 | 是否必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| positionId | Long | 是 | 逐仓仓位 ID |
| autoAppendMargin | Boolean | 是 | 是否启用自动追加逐仓保证金 |

**请求示例**

```
curl -X POST "https://api-contract.weex.com/capi/v3/account/modifyAutoAppendMargin" \
   -H "ACCESS-KEY:*******" \
   -H "ACCESS-SIGN:*******" \
   -H "ACCESS-PASSPHRASE:*****" \
   -H "ACCESS-TIMESTAMP:1659076670000" \
   -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
   -d '{"positionId":689987235755328154,"autoAppendMargin":false}'
```

**返回参数**

| 参数名 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| code | String | 返回码 |
| msg | String | 返回信息 |
| requestTime | Long | 时间戳 Unix 毫秒时间戳 |

**返回示例**

```
{
  "code": "200",
  "msg": "success",
  "requestTime": 1764505776347
}
```
